embeds.title: 📊 WoW Market Briefing · Nov 22
embeds.description:
**Verdict**
• Crafting is thin today. The best non-cooldown crafts pay 11-13g but have only **3 listings** each.
• Best buy: **Arcane Crystal** at 67% of usual price with stock at 54% of usual.
• No ladder flips pass the movement gate.
• The market is still falling about **5% a day**. Buy only what you will use soon.
